operating_notes.text: Board approved transfer of 40% of Avito Global Freight Private Limited to its core operating team for ₹92.12 lakh, retaining 60%.
Board approved incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary of Avito Global Freight in Masdar City Free Zone, Abu Dhabi, with subscription of up to ₹7.00 Cr.
Board approved a corporate guarantee to Techombank of up to VND 30,000,000,000 (≈₹11.00 Cr) for Skyways SLS Logistik Company Limited (Vietnam).
Material subsidiary Brace Port Logistics agreed to acquire a 76% stake in Sageroute Logistics Private Limited for ₹76,000 with a subsequent capital infusion of ₹75.24 lakh.
Invested ₹3.13 Cr in Dubai subsidiary Skyways SLS Cargo Services LLC for working capital, raising stake to 90%.

timeline.summary: Skyways Air approved a 40% stake dilution in subsidiary Avito Global Freight to its core team, incorporation of a UAE step-down subsidiary, and a ₹11 crore guarantee for its Vietnam subsidiary.
Skyways Air's material subsidiary Brace Port Logistics agreed to acquire a 76% stake in Sageroute Logistics Private Limited.
Skyways Air made a further investment of ₹3.13 crore in its Dubai subsidiary Skyways SLS Cargo Services LLC.
